episodes.synopsis: The fight for city turf is cut short when breakfast is served. Dazai and Atsushi are on clean-up duty, and the lockers are in pretty rough shape. Higuchi forces Akutagawa and Nakahara into an awkward situation.
episodes.title: Bungo Stray Dogs REAL / What's Inside the Locker? / An Unfruitful Exchange

episodes.synopsis: Atsushi is assigned to keep a spot at the park for cherry blossom watching. The bath breaks down at headquarters, and the Agency hits the bath house.
episodes.title: Let's Go Flower Gazing! / To The Baths!

episodes.synopsis: Yosano needs some shopping done. Rampo offers to do it for her. Kyouka comes home with a lost cat.
episodes.title: Operation Errand Run / Finders Kyouka's / Rampo-san's Day Well Spent

episodes.synopsis: Dazai sends Akutagawa on some errands, but despite his best efforts, he doesn’t seem to have what it takes to go shopping.
episodes.title: Akutagawa-kun's Errands / The Mafia Member Who Doesn't Kill / Forming a Duo With Him

episodes.synopsis: Dazai and Chuya are middle schoolers who just can’t seem to get along.
episodes.title: Dazai and Chuuya, Pretentious Fourteen-Year-Olds / A Day in Yokohama / The Boy and the Puppy

episodes.synopsis: Dazai tapes a sign on Kunikida’s back as a prank, but it turns out that Kunikida was about to head to a meeting with some important people.
episodes.title: Dazai-san's Nail Biter / If Only I Could Express My Hundred Thoughts / Please Share! Armed Detective Agency!

episodes.synopsis: The gang are in preschool, and Dazai is in charge. Atsushi and Akutagawa vie for his attention.
episodes.title: Bungo Stray Dogs Preschool

episodes.synopsis: Akutagawa catches the flu. Ichiyo does everything in her power to help him, but she just can’t seem to make things work.
episodes.title: Hang in There, Higuchi-san! / And the Tracks Go On and On / Operation Body Double Nom Nom

episodes.synopsis: Yosano realizes that her scalpel is missing. Worried that she might have left it in one of her patients, she panics.
episodes.title: Dr. Yosano's Whoopsies! Forgetfulness / Miscellany on Shrimp Tails / Me Drawing You Drawing Me

episodes.synopsis: Dazai decides to make oden on a cold, cold winter day, but there’s only one problem: he doesn’t know how to make oden.
episodes.title: Oden with the White Tiger / Elevator Panic / The Armed Detective Agency Beats the Heat

episodes.synopsis: Dazai decides to write new year’s greeting cards, but it’s not clear if he has the humanity to pull it off.
episodes.title: The Dark Era

episodes.synopsis: Dazai and Atsushi swap minds when they bonk heads. Datsushi doesn’t mind, but Azai wants him to stay out of trouble. Atsushi tries to get back at Dazai for all the times he’d surprised him.
episodes.title: Swap Theater / My Treasure / Nakajima Atsushi's Plan
